_note: Wizard (2024), a full caster (slots from tables.fullCasterSlots). Base class + Evoker are SRD 5.2 (CC-BY); Abjurer / Diviner / Illusionist are mechanics + original descriptions.

classes.name: Wizard
startingEquipment: 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Quarterstaff), Robe, Spellbook, Scholar's Pack, 5 GP
classes.flavor: A scholar of the arcane whose spellbook is an arsenal — preparing exactly the right spells for the day and bending raw magic to precise, devastating effect.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You cast Wizard spells using Intelligence, drawing them from a Spellbook. Each day after a Long Rest you prepare a number of spells from the book (shown on the table) plus cantrips. Your spell save DC is 8 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus, and your attack bonus is Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus. You can copy new spells you find into your book for a cost of time and gold.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: You can cast any spell in your Spellbook that has the Ritual tag as a Ritual, even if it isn't prepared.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day on a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up), none of them level 6 or higher.

features.name: Scholar
features.description: You gain Expertise (double proficiency) in one skill of your choice from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion (you must already be proficient).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can swap one prepared spell for another from your Spellbook.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Choose one level 1 and one level 2 spell in your Spellbook; you can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot. You can swap the choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Spell Recall is a fitting choice.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Choose two level 3 spells in your Spellbook as Signature Spells; they're always prepared and you can cast each once at level 3 without a slot, regaining the ability on a Short or Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Evoker
subclasses.flavor: A master of raw elemental force who shapes blasts around allies and squeezes every point of damage from a spell.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Evocation spells cost less time and gold to copy into your book, and you always have two Evocation spells prepared without counting against your prepared limit.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When a creature succeeds on a save against your cantrip, it still takes half the cantrip's damage (and suffers no other effect).

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, you can protect a number of them (1 + the spell's level): they automatically succeed on their save and take no damage from the spell.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: You add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: When you cast a Wizard spell of level 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with it. The first use each Long Rest is free; each further use before a Long Rest deals escalating Necrotic damage to you.

subclasses.name: Abjurer
subclasses.flavor: A warding specialist who wraps themselves in a self-renewing shield of magic and unravels hostile spells.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Abjuration spells cost less to copy into your book, and you gain an Arcane Ward: when you cast an Abjuration spell, a pool of Temporary-HP-like ward force absorbs damage to you (its size scales with the spell level and your Wizard level, recharging as you cast more abjurations).

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your Reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb that damage instead.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: You always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared, and when you cast either using a higher-level slot its effectiveness improves.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells, and Resistance to the damage of spells.

subclasses.name: Diviner
subclasses.flavor: A seer who glimpses the strands of fate and rewrites a roll of the dice before it lands.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Divination spells cost less to copy, and you gain Portent: after a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record them. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check (yours or a creature's you can see) with one of these foretold rolls.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a Divination spell of level 2 or higher, you regain an expended spell slot of a lower level.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: As a Bonus Action you gain one benefit until your next rest: Darkvision, an increased understanding of a language, See Invisibility, or greater awareness of your surroundings.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: You roll three d20s for your Portent feature instead of two.

subclasses.name: Illusionist
subclasses.flavor: A weaver of deception whose illusions grow so convincing they gain a sliver of reality.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Illusion spells cost less to copy, and your Minor Illusion improves: you can create both a sound and an image at once, and shape the illusion as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: You always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared, and can cast either once without a slot per Long Rest, conjuring an illusory creature.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, you can use a Reaction to interpose an illusory duplicate, causing the attack to miss. Recharge on a rest, or by expending a spell slot.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: When you cast an Illusion spell of level 1+, you can make one inanimate, nonmagical part of the illusion real for 1 minute — a bridge you can cross, a wall that blocks, and so on.

subclasses.name: Conjurer
subclasses.flavor: A Wizard who treats distance and matter as flexible guidelines — teleporting across space and calling creatures from thin air to fight alongside them.

features.name: Benign Transposition
features.description: As a Bonus Action you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, or swap places with a willing Medium or smaller creature. Intelligence-modifier uses (min 1), regained on a Long Rest.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: Add two Conjuration spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more Conjuration spell each time you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Distant Transposition
features.description: Benign Transposition's range increases to 60 feet, and you can restore one use by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: A creature you summon or create with a Conjuration spell slot gains Temporary HP equal to twice your Wizard level, and while it has them it has Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

features.name: Splintered Summons
features.description: When you cast a Conjuration spell that summons a spirit with a stat block, you can summon two creatures instead of one, each with half the Hit Points. Once per Long Rest, or by expending a level 5+ spell slot.

subclasses.name: Enchanter
subclasses.flavor: A Wizard whose magic clouds and captivates minds — soothing cruelty or bending others to selfish ends through charm and beguilement.

features.name: Enchanting Conversationalist
features.description: Gain proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion. When you make a check with the chosen skill, add your Intelligence modifier (min +1) to the roll.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.description: Add two Enchantment spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more Enchantment spell each time you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Hypnotic Presence
features.description: As a Magic action, a creature within 10 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom save or be Charmed for 1 minute (Incapacitated, Speed 0) until it is far away, can't perceive you, or takes damage. Intelligence-modifier uses (min 1), regained on a Long Rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.description: When you cast an Enchantment spell that can target an extra creature at a higher level, you can raise its effective level by 1. Intelligence-modifier uses, regained on a Long Rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet hits you with an attack, you can take a Reaction to force a Wisdom save; on a failure the attack misses and may be redirected to another creature in range. Once per Long Rest, or restore it by casting an Enchantment spell with a slot.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.description: When you cast an Enchantment spell that Charms using a slot, one target is unaware it was Charmed. Once before the spell ends you can make that creature fail an Intelligence save to lose 1 + your Intelligence modifier hours of memory.

subclasses.name: Necromancer
subclasses.flavor: A Wizard who manipulates the energy animating all creatures, drawing power from forbidden secrets to command the forces of death and undeath.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.description: Add two Necromancy spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more Necromancy spell each time you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Necromancy Spellbook
features.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. Find Familiar appears in your spellbook and can summon a Skeleton or Zombie (or an Undead-type normal form), and you can forgo an attack to let it attack. When you cast a Necromancy spell with a slot, an Undead you can see within 60 feet regains HP equal to the slot level + your Wizard level.

features.name: Grave Power
features.description: While holding your spellbook: Arcane Recovery also lowers your Exhaustion by 1, and your Wizard spells and features ignore Resistance to Necrotic damage.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.description: You always have Animate Dead prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, raising its effective level by 1. While holding your spellbook, Undead you create gain HP equal to your Int modifier + half your Wizard level, and Undead you control deal extra Necrotic damage equal to your Int modifier on a hit.

features.name: Harvest Undead
features.description: Right after you become Bloodied without dropping to 0 HP, you can take a Reaction to reduce an Undead you control to 0 HP and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

features.name: Death's Master
features.description: While holding your spellbook: as a Bonus Action, Undead you created within 60 feet gain Temporary HP equal to your Wizard level (once per Long Rest). When an Undead you can see drops to 0 HP, it can explode for Necrotic damage in a 10-ft Emanation (half the creature's Hit Dice in d6s).

subclasses.name: Transmuter
subclasses.flavor: A Wizard who reshapes energy and matter at reality's forge — a smith of a mutable world, from harmless tricks to the power to make and unmake.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.description: Add two Transmutation spells (level 2 or lower) to your spellbook for free, and one more Transmutation spell each time you gain a new level of spell slots.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description: On a Long Rest you create a magic stone usable as a Spellcasting Focus. Its bearer gains Constitution save proficiency plus one benefit you choose: Darkvision 60 ft., Resistance to a chosen damage type, or +10 ft. Speed. You can change the benefit when you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot.

features.name: Wondrous Alteration
features.description: You always have Alter Self prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a slot. Each of its options gains an extra benefit (a Bonus Action Dash underwater, Advantage on Deception, or 2d6 natural-weapon damage with Concentration Advantage).

features.name: Empowered Transmutation
features.description: When you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot that makes no attack roll or save, you can raise its effective level by 1. Intelligence-modifier uses (min 1), regained on a Long Rest.

features.name: Potent Stone
features.description: Your Transmuter's Stone can hold up to two benefits, now also including Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves, larger carrying capacity) and Tremorsense 30 ft.

features.name: Shape-Shifter
features.description: You always have Polymorph prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a slot. When you target yourself, once per Long Rest you can keep your memories, mental abilities, proficiencies, class features, and feats, and cast Transmutation spells while transformed.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.description: As a Magic action you can consume your Transmuter's Stone (it then crumbles, unless you spend a level 7+ slot) for one effect: Major Transformation (change a nonmagical object into another of similar size), Panacea (heal half max HP and cure contagions, curses, Poisoned/Petrified), Restore Life (cast Raise Dead without components), or Restore Youth (end Exhaustion and appear 3d10 years younger).
